proc fastStream() {.async.} =
  let socket = newAsyncSocket()
  await socket.connect("api.cerebras.ai", Port(443))
  
  let headers = "POST /v1/chat/completions HTTP/1.1\r\n" &
    "Host: api.cerebras.ai\r\n" &
    "Authorization: Bearer " & getEnv("CEREBRAS_API_KEY") & "\r\n" &
    "ContentType: application/json\r\n" &
    "Connection: keepalive\r\n"
  
  let body = %{
    "model": "gptoss120b",
    "messages": [{"role": "system", "content": ""}],
    "stream": true,
    "max_completion_tokens": 65536,
    "temperature": 0.09,
    "top_p": 0.05,
    "reasoning_effort": "low"
  }
  
  let request = headers & "ContentLength: " & $body.len & "\r\n\r\n" & $body
  await socket.send(request)
  
   Skip HTTP headers
  while true:
    let line = await socket.recvLine()
    if line == "": break
  
   Process SSE stream
  while true:
    let line = await socket.recvLine()
    if line.startsWith(" "):
      let data = line[6..^1].strip()
      if data == "[DONE]": break
      try:
        let chunk = parseJson(data)
        let content = chunk["choices"][0]["delta"].getOrDefault("content")
        if not content.isNil:
          stdout.write(content.getStr())
          stdout.flushFile()
      except: discard
  
  socket.close()

waitFor fastStream()

import net, strutils, json, os, asyncdispatch

proc exaUltraFast(query: string) {.async.} =
  let socket = newAsyncSocket()
  await socket.connect("api.exa.ai", Port(443))
  
  let body = %{
    "query": query,
    "type": "fast",
    "numResults": 100,
    "livecrawl": "never"   kritikus a sebességhez
  }
  
  let bodyStr = $body
  let headers = "POST /search HTTP/1.1\r\n" &
    "Host: api.exa.ai\r\n" &
    "Authorization: Bearer " & getEnv("EXA_API_KEY") & "\r\n" &
    "ContentType: application/json\r\n" &
    "ContentLength: " & $bodyStr.len & "\r\n" &
    "Connection: close\r\n\r\n"
  
  await socket.send(headers & bodyStr)
  
   HTTP headers átugrása
  while true:
    let line = await socket.recvLine()
    if line == "": break
  
   JSON válasz olvasása
  var response = ""
  while true:
    let chunk = await socket.recv(1024)
    if chunk.len == 0: break
    response.add(chunk)
  
  let jsonData = parseJson(response)
  echo jsonData.pretty()
  socket.close()

proc fastStream() {.async.} =
  let socket = newAsyncSocket()
  await socket.connect("api.cerebras.ai", Port(443))
  
  let headers = "POST /v1/chat/completions HTTP/1.1\r\n" &
    "Host: api.cerebras.ai\r\n" &
    "Authorization: Bearer " & getEnv("CEREBRAS_API_KEY") & "\r\n" &
    "ContentType: application/json\r\n" &
    "Connection: keepalive\r\n"
  
  let body = %{
    "model": "gptoss120b",
    "messages": [{"role": "system", "content": ""}],
    "stream": true,
    "max_completion_tokens": 65536,
    "temperature": 0.09,
    "top_p": 0.05,
    "reasoning_effort": "low"
  }
  
  let request = headers & "ContentLength: " & $body.len & "\r\n\r\n" & $body
  await socket.send(request)
  
   Skip HTTP headers
  while true:
    let line = await socket.recvLine()
    if line == "": break
  
   Process SSE stream
  while true:
    let line = await socket.recvLine()
    if line.startsWith(" "):
      let data = line[6..^1].strip()
      if data == "[DONE]": break
      try:
        let chunk = parseJson(data)
        let content = chunk["choices"][0]["delta"].getOrDefault("content")
        if not content.isNil:
          stdout.write(content.getStr())
          stdout.flushFile()
      except: discard
  
  socket.close()

waitFor fastStream()

import net, strutils, json, os, asyncdispatch

proc exaUltraFast(query: string) {.async.} =
  let socket = newAsyncSocket()
  await socket.connect("api.exa.ai", Port(443))
  
  let body = %{
    "query": query,
    "type": "fast",
    "numResults": 100,
    "livecrawl": "never"   kritikus a sebességhez
  }
  
  let bodyStr = $body
  let headers = "POST /search HTTP/1.1\r\n" &
    "Host: api.exa.ai\r\n" &
    "Authorization: Bearer " & getEnv("EXA_API_KEY") & "\r\n" &
    "ContentType: application/json\r\n" &
    "ContentLength: " & $bodyStr.len & "\r\n" &
    "Connection: close\r\n\r\n"
  
  await socket.send(headers & bodyStr)
  
   HTTP headers átugrása
  while true:
    let line = await socket.recvLine()
    if line == "": break
  
   JSON válasz olvasása
  var response = ""
  while true:
    let chunk = await socket.recv(1024)
    if chunk.len == 0: break
    response.add(chunk)
  
  let jsonData = parseJson(response)
  echo jsonData.pretty()
  socket.close()
